conventions.distance: Distance between vertices in different components is infinite.
conventions.maxLeaf: Maximum total leaf count of a spanning forest, not maximum component max-leaf.
conventions.reducedMaxLeaf: Isolated red vertices do not count as leaves.
conventions.chordality: Minimum number of chordal graphs whose edge intersection is the graph.
conventions.tracks: Interval-track number and track-layout number are distinct.
conventions.radiusComparison: fw_r(G) <= 4^(mw_(2r-1)(G)); the source node explicitly keeps radius 2r-1. All-radius merge-width -> flip-width also remains.
conventions.publicationScope: Newly proposed H-free classes and their intersection nodes are deferred; the existing Claw-free class remains. The homepage hierarchy contains only undirected graph parameters.
conventions.parameterFamilies: Fixed-host and fixed-radius family nodes require uniform parameters throughout each represented graph class; they are not unrestricted unions.
conventions.neighborhoodComplexity: Count traces N_G(v) intersect A over all vertices, including v in A; A is nonempty.
conventions.componentOrderConnectivity: kappa_r is a minimum vertex-deletion number leaving components of order at most fixed r. The r-CoC family node has fixed r>=2 and a uniform deletion bound; r=1 is vertex cover. Dissociation deletion is kappa_2, not the maximum retained-set size.
conventions.unchecked: Not verified here; does not assert an open problem or a conjecture.
